decision: Translate proven DCC Runner and Suitelet mechanics into IDB write-path requirements before expanding record scope.

location is read with subsidiary and reused across item, routing, planning, and transaction context
writes apply subsidiary before dependent list fields

dccMechanicsToPort.requirement: Account Context V2 must resolve subsidiary, location, tax schedule, currency, terms, department, class, and lane-required defaults before any expanded write.

dccEvidence: mustFindByExternalId('vendor', ANCHORS.vendor)
ensurePreferredVendorOnItem scans itemvendor/vendors/vendor sublists
vendor is set preferred and validated before planning is trusted
dccMechanicsToPort.requirement: IDB must lookup vendor from packet/account configuration, attach preferred vendor when safe, and block on missing or ambiguous vendor rather than silently creating one.

dccEvidence: forcePlanningAutoCalcOffForItems
hardenItemProcurementPlanning
seedItemLocationPlanningDetail
forceLocationSublistAutoCalcOff
forceItemLocationConfigAutoCalcOff
dccMechanicsToPort.requirement: IDB must show planning behavior in Review before write, default pilot proof items to stable planning behavior, and return trace evidence for changed planning fields.

dccEvidence: createNewHeroItem controls fresh versus anchor mode

fresh hero reuses anchor planning/vendor persistence path
dccMechanicsToPort.idbState: drawer has New item toggle, but write path treats proof item as simple create/update
dccMechanicsToPort.requirement: Proof Item V2 must preserve New item semantics and avoid splitting logic between new and reused proof records.

dccEvidence: runner starts from validated runtime parameters
parents and item setup complete before downstream transaction CSV/import handoff
work order and routing are gated behind manufacturing/WIP flags
dccMechanicsToPort.idbState: Customer then Proof Item sequencing is proven; transaction remains blocked
dccMechanicsToPort.requirement: Transaction context readiness must require stable Customer and Proof Item IDs/URLs plus explicit transaction-context enablement.

dccEvidence: buildSoCsv produces header and line context from customerId, itemInternalId, location, memo, and dates
submitCsvImport is a separate task handoff, not mixed into the item create step
dccMechanicsToPort.idbState: transaction plan exists but create remains disabled
dccMechanicsToPort.requirement: Sales Order context write must be a separate governed pilot after W48, with parent IDs, location, memo, and line item explicitly traceable.

dccEvidence: Suitelet preserves extId, notes file, runner task id, refresh URL, and runner status
refresh/status actions do not rerun unsafe work silently
dccMechanicsToPort.idbState: Trace export and clear session exist; write result import exists
dccMechanicsToPort.requirement: Drawer Write Result UX V2 must show created/updated links, blocked dependents, reset guidance, and evidence export without repeating long gate text.

requiredPromptRoles.goal: Keep only DCC mechanics that protect write correctness, demo usability, or rollback evidence.
Port account context, vendor, planning, and transaction sequencing into explicit governed SuiteScript phases.
Prevent broad record expansion, silent writes, or hidden field changes.
Turn write mechanics into one compact consultant-facing summary instead of exposing implementation noise.

recommendedSequence: W43 Account Context Admin Resolver V2
W44 Vendor Attach And Procurement Defaults
W47 Drawer Write Result UX V2
W49 Sales Order Context Write Pilot
W52 Release Candidate And Completion Gate
blockerSummary: Do not enable Sales Order writes until Customer and Proof Item write evidence is stable after vendor/planning hardening.
Do not let the item writer remain simple; DCC proved vendor and planning persistence matter for demo credibility.
Do not expose DCC mechanics as consultant noise; expose only what will be created or updated, why it matters, and what evidence came back.
